fact: The Eswatini Communications Commission published on its website a proposed broadcasting licence fee schedule and invited written comments from stakeholders and the public by email until 11 August 2025.

Eswatini's Communications Commission published General Notice 12/2024 with a proposed decision to retire 2G and 3G networks, available on its website, and invited written comments by email to legal@esccom.org.sz by 9 December 2024.
